description: Disable SSH root login and restart sshd on production (new config rollout)

playbook.content:
- name: Harden SSH config
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^PermitRootLogin'
        line: 'PermitRootLogin no'
    - ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

tier_rationale: New config rollout to production — canary required
